kingbase-sqlserver-predicate-subquery-source-in-bind-order
items.sql:
SELECT p.ID, p.A, p.B
FROM KDES.DBP_COV_SUBQ032_P p
WHERE p.A IN (
    SELECT q.A
    FROM KDES.DBP_COV_SUBQ032_Q q
    WHERE q.B = @b1
)
AND p.ID <= @b2
ORDER BY p.ID

patch.deparse: SELECT p.ID, p.A, p.B FROM KDES.DBP_COV_SUBQ032_P p WHERE p.A IN (SELECT q.B FROM KDES.DBP_COV_SUBQ032_Q q WHERE q.B = @b1) AND p.ID <= @b2 ORDER BY p.ID

items.name: kingbase-sqlserver-predicate-subquery-source-not-in-bind-order
items.sql:
SELECT p.ID, p.A, p.B
FROM KDES.DBP_COV_SUBQ033_P p
WHERE p.A NOT IN (
    SELECT q.A
    FROM KDES.DBP_COV_SUBQ033_Q q
    WHERE q.B = @b1
      AND q.ID <= @b2
)
AND p.ID <= @b3
ORDER BY p.ID
